title: Big Cat Rescue
specs: Founded in 1992 with a focus on wild cat protection and conservation
Funds conservation projects globally to protect wildcats from poaching, trafficking, and habitat loss
Invited to the IUCN SSC Cat Specialist Group in 2026, monitoring and conserving all 40 wild cat species
gap: No information on visitor experiences, tours, or public access
blurb: Big Cat Rescue works to protect wild cats by advocating for legislation such as the U.S. federal Big Cat Public Safety Act. They fund conservation projects globally to protect wildcats in their natural habitats from threats like poaching and trafficking. Their mission is to create a world where wildcats live freely and safely in the wild.
